provenance.source: RuneScape Wiki current revisions via public MediaWiki API
provenance.inventoryPolicy: Explicit inventory/worn variants retain their separate numeric weights. Otherwise the verified item/bonuses infobox weight is used for both contexts; no separate in-game measurement is claimed.
provenance.fieldPolicy: Infobox Item weight is primary. Numeric Infobox Bonuses weight is accepted only for an explicitly matching variant or one shared unsuffixed bonus template. Conflicting numeric facts are withheld. Each source records the exact field and suffix.
provenance.identityPolicy: All exact equippable cache candidate IDs must appear in Wiki infobox variants. Weights must agree across candidates, except explicit inventory/worn identities. Missing facts stay unresolved.
